title: [CQ-M07k] Per-account VM tokens for rotation accounts
description:
Slice of CQ-M07 (task-1a8f1d0e199046a289e94a5453d758b8). Design: mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation, decision 5 (human, 2026-11-01: per-account tokens).

Objective: a VM agent job for a claude seat can use the seat's leased rotation account without the wrapper reading any Claude config folder. The human's 2026-10-26 sign-off forbids opening an account's .credentials.json, and the guest accepts only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN for claude (scripts/local-runner/guest-bridge.mjs, the job frame).

Deliverable:
- accounts CLI (packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/cli.ts) subcommand `vm-token <id>`: obtain a long-lived token for that rotation account and store it at <dir of the accounts list>/claude-vm-tokens/<id>.token, next to ~/.moe/claude-accounts.json (MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE moves both in tests). Dir 0700 and file 0600 on POSIX; exclusive temp file then rename. The store is outside every Claude config folder and every project. `vm-token <id> --remove` deletes it.
  - How the token is obtained is the planner's call, with the reason: run `claude setup-token` under that account's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and capture the token from its output (MOE_CLAUDE_BIN fakes it in tests, as the existing CLI tests do), or a hidden paste prompt if capturing setup-token's interactive output is unreliable.
  - The token is never printed, logged, put in an argv, put in an env (except the minting child's own) or sent to the daemon.
  - Risk to answer in the plan: a minted token could belong to a different Claude account than the rotation entry. Say how the plan detects that, or document it.
- Wrapper-side reader in scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs, subcommand `vm-credential <id>`: writes only the token to stdout, for a pipe into the VM job runner (never argv). It reads only from that store (regular file, no symlink, size cap, exact token shape); anything else prints nothing and exits with a fixed code.
- The daemon's account projection (what the JetBrains Accounts tab reads) reports token presence as a boolean from a stat. The daemon never opens the token file.

NOT in scope: the Accounts tab button (CQ-M07l), the wrappers' use (CQ-M07m/n), codex keys (they come from the wrapper's environment).

Verification, in a git-archive snapshot with this task's files overlaid, under env -i with the nvm Node 24 PATH: cd <snapshot>/packages/moe-daemon && npm ci && npx vitest run src/accounts/ && cd <snapshot> && node --test scripts/tests/moe-account-lease.test.mjs
definitionOfDone: `accounts vm-token <id>` with a fake claude stores the token at the store path with POSIX modes 0700/0600 and prints no token byte (vitest on cli.ts with MOE_CLAUDE_BIN).
`vm-token <id> --remove` deletes the file; an unknown id or a failed mint stores nothing and exits non-zero with a fixed message (vitest).
`moe-account-lease.mjs vm-credential <id>` prints exactly the stored token; a missing, symlinked, oversize or malformed token file prints nothing and exits with a fixed code (node --test rows).
The account projection reports vmToken true or false from a stat, and no daemon code path reads the token bytes (vitest).
Both named test commands pass in a git-archive snapshot.
taskRails: Never open a file inside a Claude config folder (claude-accounts/<id>) and never read .credentials.json.
No token byte in any argv, log line, chat message, task comment or daemon payload.

implementationPlan.description:
Build the token store, and make both registry removal paths delete it. Read `mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation` (decision 5) and `mem:task-task-324d4f53cf28486d8bc0de70b6a99b8d-handoff` first.

**Size budget for the WHOLE task: at most 400 net changed lines (added minus deleted) across all 8 files.** QA rejects anything larger, and three CQ-M rows (M05, M07b, M07q) were size-rejected for exactly this (`mem:gotcha-cq-plan-size-vs-qa-cap`).
- Targets, runtime ~175: registry.ts +10, vmTokens.ts ~70, cli.ts +40, accountStore.ts +8, moe-account-lease.mjs +45.
- Targets, tests ~220: vmTokens.test.ts ~160, accountStore.test.ts +16, moe-account-lease.test.mjs +45.
- Use it.each tables for the rows this plan lists, and add no other matrix. Step 5 says what to do if the total still ends up over.

**1. packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/registry.ts** (keep it under 300 lines).
- Add `vmTokenFile(registryFile, id)` beside accountUsageFile: `path.join(path.dirname(registryFile), 'claude-vm-tokens', `${id}.token`)`.
  - An id failing ACCOUNT_ID_RE throws RegistryError('MOE_ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN', 'not a valid account id'). Don't echo the id.
  - The store sits beside claude-accounts.json, so it is outside every Claude config folder (claude-accounts/<id>) and every project.
- Add `fs.rmSync(vmTokenFile(file, id), { force: true })` beside the existing usage-file rmSync, in BOTH places:
  - addAccount (:230, inside the update), so a reused acct-n never inherits a stale token. Ids are reused once the config folder is gone (:227).
  - removeAccount (:243, after the update). This covers the CLI's `remove` and also the Accounts tab's "Remove only": /ws REMOVE_ACCOUNT (server/accountMessages.ts:48) calls removeAccount and never goes through cli.ts.
  - Update removeAccount's doc comment: its usage file and VM token are deleted; the config folder still stays.
- Extract writeJsonAtomic's body (:165) into `writeTextAtomic(file, text)`, for reuse instead of a second hand-rolled atomic write.
  - Keep the same mkdir, temp name, Windows rename retry (EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES) and temp removal on failure.
  - The temp write gains flag 'wx', so an existing temp path (even a planted symlink) fails instead of being followed.
  - writeJsonAtomic becomes one line that calls it. Registry and usage files keep exactly the same bytes.

**2. New packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/vmTokens.ts.** Runtime imports are node built-ins and ./registry.js only: accounts/ never imports daemon modules (packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md). It exports NO function that reads a token; the only reader is the wrapper's helper (step 4).
- `VM_TOKEN_RE = /^sk-ant-oat\d{2}-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,1000}$/` and `MAX_VM_TOKEN_BYTES = 1100`.
  - This matches a Claude long-lived OAuth token as `claude setup-token` prints it.
  - If the format changes, the check refuses (fails closed), and step 4's drift row forces moe-account-lease.mjs to change in the same diff.
- `writeVmToken(registryFile, id, token)`:
  - A token failing VM_TOKEN_RE throws Error('MOE_VM_TOKEN_INVALID: not a Claude long-lived token'), never including the value.
  - file = vmTokenFile(...), dir = path.dirname(file). mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 }).
  - lstat(dir) must be a real directory. A symlink or a file refuses with MOE_VM_TOKEN_NOT_STORED naming the dir.
  - On POSIX, chmodSync(dir, 0o700). Then writeTextAtomic(file, token), and on POSIX chmodSync(file, 0o600).
- `removeVmToken(registryFile, id): boolean`: unlinkSync. ENOENT returns false; any other error is rethrown.
- `hasVmToken(registryFile, id): boolean`: lstatSync(file).isFile() inside a try. A symlink, a directory, a missing file or an invalid id is false. It never opens the file.

**3. Tests: new packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/vmTokens.test.ts, part 1.** Use a mkdtemp registry per test and a token constant with a varied body, such as `sk-ant-oat01-${'Q7x_Lm2-Zp9K'.repeat(4)}`.
- The written file holds exactly the token. On POSIX the dir is 0700 and the file 0600 (skip the mode asserts on win32). A rewrite replaces the file and leaves no *.tmp in the dir.
- it.each refused tokens: '', 'sk-ant-api03-' plus 40 characters, the token plus '\n', a token with an inner space, and a 1001-character body. Each throws MOE_VM_TOKEN_INVALID, the message doesn't contain the input, and no file exists.
- it.each refused ids: '../x', 'a/b' and ''. Each throws RegistryError and nothing is written.
- A symlinked store dir refuses (POSIX; skip on EPERM).
- removeVmToken returns true, then false.
- hasVmToken is true for the file, and false for a missing file, a directory and a symlink to a valid token file.
- removeAccount: with acct-1 and acct-2 each holding a token, removing acct-1 deletes acct-1's token and leaves acct-2's.
- addAccount: a stale acct-1 token written while no account exists is gone after addAccount returns acct-1.

Error handling: every fs failure surfaces as a thrown error carrying only an error code and a path, never the token, and writeTextAtomic removes its temp file on every failure path.
implementationPlan.note: registry.ts: vmTokenFile (invalid id -> RegistryError MOE_ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN, no echo); token rmSync in addAccount (inside update) and removeAccount; writeTextAtomic extracted (wx temp, temp removed on non-EEXIST write failure and rename failure, Windows retry kept), writeJsonAtomic delegates with identical bytes. vmTokens.ts: VM_TOKEN_RE, MAX_VM_TOKEN_BYTES, writeVmToken (symlinked dir refused, chmod 0700/0600 on POSIX), removeVmToken, hasVmToken (lstat only); no reader exported. Iteration run in /tmp snapshot (env -i, nvm node 24): vmTokens.test.ts + registry.test.ts + atomicWrite.test.ts 41/41 passed. Mutants killed 4/4: drop removeAccount rm, drop addAccount rm, drop symlinked-dir check, lstat->stat in hasVmToken. Dirty peer paths in the shared tree (.moe/roles, .moe/skills, scripts/local-runner, other tasks' .moe/tasks) untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
Add `accounts vm-token <id> [--remove]` to packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/cli.ts (keep it under 300 lines; it is 246 now). Add its rows to vmTokens.test.ts and the hidden reader to vmTokens.ts, both created in step 1.

**How the token is obtained, and why.** `claude setup-token` is an interactive Ink TUI. With stdout piped, its sign-in link and code prompt may not render, and a token split across chunks could leak a prefix through any redaction. So the CLI runs it INTERACTIVELY (stdio inherited) under the account's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, then asks the person to paste the token at a HIDDEN prompt. The task allows this choice.

**1. Hidden reader, in vmTokens.ts.** Putting it there keeps cli.ts under 300 lines.
- `HIDDEN_READER_SOURCE`: a static, single-line CommonJS snippet for `node -e`, containing no double quotes. It:
  - writes process.argv[1] (the prompt) to stderr;
  - creates readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: a stream.Writable whose write() drops the chunk, terminal: process.stdin.isTTY === true }). On a TTY readline sets raw mode, so nothing echoes;
  - on the first 'line', writes the line to stdout and closes the interface;
  - on rl 'SIGINT', closes the interface. In raw mode Ctrl-C reaches readline instead of the process, and with no listener readline only pauses, so the prompt would hang until the timeout;
  - on 'close', writes '\n' to stderr and sets process.exitCode to 0 if a line was read, else 1.
  - It must NOT call process.exit: on POSIX a pipe write is asynchronous, and process.exit can drop it.
- `readHiddenLine(prompt): string | null` = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', HIDDEN_READER_SOURCE, prompt], { stdio: ['inherit', 'pipe', 'inherit'], encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 15 * 60_000 }). It returns stdout when the status is 0, else null.
- The secret crosses only that pipe: never argv, an env, the screen or a log.

**2. cli.ts.**
- CliIo gains an OPTIONAL `readSecret?(prompt: string): string | null`, and vm-token uses `io.readSecret ?? readHiddenLine`. Optional keeps every existing CliIo literal valid (cli.test.ts:80, claudeAuth.test.ts:52). runAccountsCli stays synchronous, as index.ts:1213 needs.
- ParsedArgs gains `remove`, and parseArgs accepts `--remove`.
- USAGE and the header comment gain `vm-token <id> [--remove]  mint (or delete) the account's long-lived token for Moe VM jobs`.
- `case 'vm-token'` starts with account = accountFor(file, positional[0]). An unknown id gives the existing MOE_ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN and exit 1; a missing id gives usage and exit 2.
  - **--remove:** call removeVmToken. Print 'Removed the VM token for <describe>.' or '<describe> has no VM token.', then exit 0.
  - **Mint:**
    a. mkdirSync(accountConfigDir(file, id), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 }), as login does. No file inside the folder is opened.
    b. On stderr: 'Minting a long-lived token for <describe> for Moe VM jobs. Claude opens its sign-in page (or prints a link). Sign in with the SAME Claude account as this slot: Moe cannot check which account a token belongs to.' Then: 'When claude prints the token, copy it; you paste it here next (input hidden).'
    c. run = runClaude(claudeCommand(io.env), ['setup-token'], accountEnv(io.env, dir), true). accountEnv drops TOKEN_ENV and PROVIDER_ENV, so no outer token reaches the minting child.
    d. If run.notFound, print notFoundMessage and exit 1. If the status is not 0, print `MOE_VM_TOKEN_MINT_FAILED: claude setup-token exited with <status|no exit code>; nothing was stored.` and exit 1, without ever calling readSecret.
    e. token = readSecret('Paste the token (input hidden): ')?.trim().
       - Empty or null: `MOE_VM_TOKEN_NOT_STORED: no token was entered; nothing was stored.` and exit 1.
       - Fails VM_TOKEN_RE: `MOE_VM_TOKEN_INVALID: that is not a Claude long-lived token (sk-ant-oat…); nothing was stored.` and exit 1. Never echo the input.
    f. Call accountFor(file, id) again. If the account was removed while the prompt waited, the existing MOE_ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN fires and nothing is stored.
    g. writeVmToken. A throw prints `MOE_VM_TOKEN_NOT_STORED: the token store could not be written (<error code>); nothing was stored.` and exits 1. On success, print on stdout 'Stored a VM token for <describe>. Moe uses it only to run this account's agent jobs in a Moe VM.' and exit 0.
- `remove <id>` is NOT changed. registry.removeAccount deletes the token (step 1), and remove's output stays byte-for-byte the same.

**3. Tests: vmTokens.test.ts, part 2.** Use cli.test.ts's MOE_CLAUDE_BIN pattern, and inject io.readSecret.
- A minimal fake claude (.mjs) handles `setup-token`. It appends to a log file its CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and the NAMES (never the values) of the TOKEN_ENV and PROVIDER_ENV variables it received. It prints nothing token-like and exits FAKE_SETUP_EXIT (default 0). The outer env sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN and CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK.
- **Mint:** exit 0, and the store holds exactly the token with step 1's modes. No out or err line contains the token or any 12-character slice of it (DoD 1). The child saw the account's config dir and none of those names.
- **Failed mint** (FAKE_SETUP_EXIT=1): exit 1 with MOE_VM_TOKEN_MINT_FAILED, readSecret never called, no file (DoD 2).
- **Bad paste** (it.each): null and '' give NOT_STORED; 'sk-ant-api03-…' gives INVALID, and the message doesn't contain the input. Nothing is stored.
- **Unknown id:** exit 1 with MOE_ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN, nothing stored (DoD 2).
- **Account removed inside readSecret:** exit 1 with MOE_ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN, nothing stored.
- **--remove:** deletes the file; a second run says there is none, exit 0.
- **Hidden reader:** spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', HIDDEN_READER_SOURCE, 'P: '], { input: TOKEN + '\n', encoding: 'utf8' }) gives status 0, stdout exactly TOKEN and stderr exactly 'P: \n'. Input '' gives status 1 and an empty stdout.

Error handling: every failure prints one fixed MOE_* line and exits 1 with nothing stored, and no message interpolates the token.
implementationPlan.note: cli.ts (299 lines): optional CliIo.readSecret, --remove flag, USAGE/header line, vmToken() runs `claude setup-token` interactively via accountEnv (TOKEN_ENV/PROVIDER_ENV dropped), then hidden paste, trim, VM_TOKEN_RE, registry re-check, writeVmToken; fixed MOE_VM_TOKEN_MINT_FAILED / NOT_STORED / INVALID lines, exit 1; `remove` unchanged. vmTokens.ts: HIDDEN_READER_SOURCE (single line, no double quotes, SIGINT closes, exitCode not process.exit) + readHiddenLine (spawnSync, stdout pipe, 15 min timeout). Tests (vmTokens.test.ts): mint (modes 0700/0600, no 12-char token slice in any output line, child saw account config dir and no credential names), failed mint (readSecret never called), bad paste x3, missing id exit 2 / unknown id / removed-during-prompt / broken store (EEXIST), --remove twice, hidden reader over a pipe. Snapshot run: tsc clean; vitest src/accounts/ 57 passed + 1 pre-existing skip. Mutants killed 4/4 (no trim, no registry re-check, no status check, outer env leak). Manual pty check via `script`: prompt shown, token NOT echoed, line only on child stdout; Ctrl-C -> exit 1, empty stdout. readHiddenLine itself (stdin inherit) is not unit-tested; its source is.

implementationPlan.description:
Report token presence in the daemon's account projection: packages/moe-daemon/src/state/accountStore.ts accountRotationView (:193). This is the ACCOUNTS_UPDATED view, and the snapshot's accountRotation, that the JetBrains Accounts tab reads.

**Where the type lives.** types/schema.ts AccountView is declared by WT-19 (task-b1ca54f2, WORKING), so do NOT edit it; this also keeps the change out of the shared schema.
- Export from accountStore.ts `interface AccountViewWithVmToken extends AccountView { vmToken: boolean }`, and annotate the accounts .map callback with it.
- Type accountRotationView's return as `AccountRotationView & { accounts: AccountViewWithVmToken[] }`, so callers see the field without a cast.
- Add a comment that the M07 integration folds vmToken into AccountView once WT-19 lands.

**The field.** Add `vmToken: hasVmToken(file, account.id)`, where file is the registryFilePath() already in scope.
- It is an lstat only: the daemon never opens the token file.
- Leave every other field and the change detection alone. A token appearing or disappearing changes the view's JSON, so the existing refresh broadcasts it.
- Always send a boolean, never omit it: M07l (task-d56fb46e) reads a missing flag as an older daemon.
- Today's plugin ignores unknown keys (moe-jetbrains MoeJson.kt parseClaudeAccount, :702-727), so the extra field is safe before M07l lands.

**Tests in packages/moe-daemon/src/state/accountStore.test.ts (DoD 4).**
- The exact `toEqual` on view.accounts[1] in describe('views') (:315-318) gains `vmToken: false`. Without it, the gate fails.
- Add a new row in describe('views'), reusing threeAccounts() and accountsFile:
  - writeVmToken(accountsFile, 'acct-1', TOKEN);
  - put a symlink at acct-3's token path pointing to acct-1's file (skip just that part on EPERM);
  - vi.spyOn fs.readFileSync and fs.openSync. The file's afterEach already calls vi.restoreAllMocks;
  - then accounts.map(a => a.vmToken) toEqual [true, false, false], and no spied call's path contains 'claude-vm-tokens'. That proves the projection stats the store and never reads it;
  - after removeVmToken(accountsFile, 'acct-1'), the next view reports false, which proves nothing is cached.

Error handling: hasVmToken never throws, so a broken store can only show false; it can never break the view or the broadcast.
implementationPlan.note: accountStore.ts: exported AccountViewWithVmToken extends AccountView { vmToken: boolean } (comment: M07 integration folds it into AccountView after WT-19); accountRotationView returns AccountRotationView & { accounts: AccountViewWithVmToken[] }; vmToken: hasVmToken(file, id) (lstat only). types/schema.ts untouched. accountStore.test.ts: exact toEqual gains vmToken:false; new views row: token on acct-1, symlink at acct-3 -> [true,false,false], readFileSync/openSync spies saw the registry file and nothing under claude-vm-tokens, removal -> false next view. ''` since ACCOUNT_ID_RE.test(undefined) would match "undefined"), readVmCredential (lstat dir real + file regular, O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW, fstat file <= MAX, bounded readSync of MAX+1, exact regex, close in finally, never throws); `vm-credential <id>`: token to stdout no newline exit 0 / stderr MOE_VM_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE exit 3 / usage exit 2. implementationPlan.description:
ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW, once, as the final step. Load adversarial-self-review, then read the whole diff as an attacker hunting for the token:
`git diff HEAD -- packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/registry.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/cli.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/state/accountStore.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/state/accountStore.test.ts scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs scripts/tests/moe-account-lease.test.mjs`, plus the two new files.

**Where the token may appear.** Only in the hidden reader's stdout pipe, writeTextAtomic's temp and final file, and vm-credential's stdout.
- Never in argv, a child env (the minting child gets none), io.out/io.err, a thrown message, a log or the projection.
- Grep every message for template strings that could interpolate it.

**Claude config folders.** Nothing opens a file inside claude-accounts/<id>, and .credentials.json is never read (task rail). The CLI only mkdirs the account folder, as login does.

**The daemon.** accountStore.ts only stats, and vmTokens.ts exports no reader. `grep -n "readFileSync\|openSync\|createReadStream" packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/vmTokens.ts` finds nothing.

**Removal paths.** The CLI's remove, /ws REMOVE_ACCOUNT and addAccount's id reuse all delete the token. remove's output is unchanged.

**Paths.** The id is validated on both sides, so '../' never escapes the store. Symlinks are refused on write (the dir), on read (the dir and the file) and for presence.

**Atomicity.** The write is 'wx' temp + rename with the Windows retry. A failure leaves neither a partial token nor a temp file, and registry and usage files keep identical bytes.

**Concurrency.** Two concurrent mints each write their own temp, and the last rename wins. A mint racing a removal re-checks the registry before writing.

**Ctrl-C** at the hidden prompt ends the reader with exit 1, which means NOT_STORED, and does not hang.

**Drift.** VM_TOKEN_RE, the size cap, ACCOUNT_ID_RE and the path rule are equal in the TS and .mjs copies.

**Account mismatch.** This is a documented limit, stated in the CLI's prompt. Moe cannot detect it without reading identity data it deliberately ignores: claudeAuth.ts takes only the exit code and authMethod.

implementationPlan.description:
Create the token store module packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/vmTokens.ts and the first rows of its test file. Read `mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation` (decision 5) first.

**Rules for the module.**
- accounts/ never imports daemon modules (packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md). Runtime imports are node built-ins and ./registry.js only.
- No token byte ever reaches an error message, a log or a return value other than the stored file.

**Exports.**
1. `VM_TOKEN_RE = /^sk-ant-oat\d{2}-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,1000}$/` and `MAX_VM_TOKEN_BYTES = 1100`.
   - This is a Claude long-lived OAuth token as `claude setup-token` prints it.
   - If the format changes, the check refuses (fail closed), and moe-account-lease.mjs's copy must change in the same diff; step 4's drift row enforces that.
2. `vmTokenDir(registryFile)` = path.join(path.dirname(registryFile), 'claude-vm-tokens'). `vmTokenFile(registryFile, id)` = `<dir>/<id>.token`. An id that fails ACCOUNT_ID_RE throws RegistryError. The store sits beside claude-accounts.json, so it is outside every Claude config folder (claude-accounts/<id>) and every project.
3. `writeVmToken(registryFile, id, token)`:
   - Validate the id and VM_TOKEN_RE. The fixed error is 'not a Claude long-lived token' and never includes the value.
   - mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 }). Then lstat the dir: a symlink or non-directory refuses. On POSIX, chmodSync(dir, 0o700).
   - Write `${file}.${process.pid}.${randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}.tmp` with { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 }, then renameSync over the file. On any failure, unlink the temp file and rethrow. On POSIX, chmodSync(file, 0o600) after.
4. `removeVmToken(registryFile, id): boolean`: unlinkSync; ENOENT returns false.
5. `hasVmToken(registryFile, id): boolean`: lstatSync(file).isFile() only. A symlink, a directory or a missing file is false. It NEVER opens the file, and an invalid id is false.

**Tests: new packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/vmTokens.test.ts, part 1.** Use a mkdtemp registry dir per test.
- Content: the written file holds exactly the token.
- Modes: the dir is 0700 and the file is 0600 (POSIX only; skip the mode asserts on win32).
- Rewrites: a rewrite replaces the file and leaves no *.tmp.
- Refused tokens, each storing nothing: '', 'sk-ant-api03-…', a token with a trailing newline or an inner space, and 1001+ body characters.
- Refused ids: '../x', 'a/b' and ''.
- removeVmToken returns true, then false.
- hasVmToken is true for the file, false for a symlink to it, false for a missing file and false for a directory.
- No error message ever contains the token text.

Error handling: every fs failure surfaces as a thrown error carrying the code only, never the token.

Add `accounts vm-token <id> [--remove]` to packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/cli.ts, and its rows in vmTokens.test.ts.

**How the token is obtained.**
- claude setup-token is an interactive Ink TUI. With stdout piped, its prompts (the sign-in link, the code paste) don't render reliably, so capturing its output is unreliable.
- The CLI therefore runs `claude setup-token` INTERACTIVELY (stdio inherited) under the account's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, then asks the person to paste the token at a HIDDEN prompt.

**1. Reading the secret.** CliIo gains `readSecret(prompt: string): string | null`.
- Export `HIDDEN_READER_SOURCE`, a static CommonJS snippet for `node -e`:
  - write process.argv[1] (the prompt) to stderr;
  - run readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: <a Writable that drops writes>, terminal: process.stdin.isTTY === true }). On a TTY that sets raw mode, so nothing echoes;
  - on the first line, write the line to stdout and exit 0; on close without a line, exit 1.
- defaultIo.readSecret = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', HIDDEN_READER_SOURCE, prompt], { stdio: ['inherit', 'pipe', 'inherit'], encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 15 * 60_000 }). It returns the stdout when the status is 0, else null.
- The secret crosses only that pipe: never argv, env, the screen or a log. Keep runAccountsCli synchronous, because cli.test.ts and index.ts:1213 call it synchronously.

**2. Arguments and usage.**
- parseArgs gains `--remove` (parsed.remove = true).
- USAGE and the header comment gain `vm-token <id> [--remove]  mint (or delete) the account's long-lived token for Moe VM jobs`.

**3. `case 'vm-token'`:** account = accountFor(file, positional[0]). An unknown id gives the existing RegistryError and exit 1, with nothing stored.
- **--remove:** removeVmToken. Print 'Removed the VM token for <describe>.' or '<describe> has no VM token.' and exit 0.
- **Mint:**
  a. mkdirSync(accountConfigDir(file, id), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 }).
  b. Print on stderr: 'Minting a long-lived token for <describe> for Moe VM jobs. Claude opens its sign-in page (or prints a link). Sign in with the SAME Claude account as this slot: Moe cannot check which account a token belongs to.' and 'When claude prints the token, copy it; you paste it here next (input hidden).'
  c. run = runClaude(claudeCommand(io.env), ['setup-token'], accountEnv(io.env, dir), true). accountEnv drops TOKEN_ENV and PROVIDER_ENV and sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, so no outer token reaches the minting child.
  d. If run.notFound, print notFoundMessage and exit 1. If the status is not 0, print `MOE_VM_TOKEN_MINT_FAILED: claude setup-token exited with <status|no exit code>; nothing was stored.` and exit 1.
  e. Take token = io.readSecret('Paste the token (input hidden): ')?.trim().
     - Empty or null: `MOE_VM_TOKEN_NOT_STORED: no token was entered; nothing was stored.` and exit 1.
     - Fails VM_TOKEN_RE: `MOE_VM_TOKEN_INVALID: that is not a Claude long-lived token (sk-ant-oat…); nothing was stored.` and exit 1. Never echo the input.
  f. writeVmToken. A throw gives `MOE_VM_TOKEN_NOT_STORED: the token store could not be written (<error code>); nothing was stored.` and exit 1. On success print 'Stored a VM token for <describe>. Moe uses it only to run this account's agent jobs in a Moe VM.' and exit 0.

**4. `remove <id>`.** After removeAccount, also call removeVmToken(file, id). Only when one existed, add the line 'Its VM token was deleted too.' A later account that reuses the id must never inherit a stale token. Existing remove output lines stay unchanged.

The fake handles `setup-token`: it exits FAKE_SETUP_EXIT (default 0) and records its CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and whether CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN were set. - **Unknown id:** exit 1, nothing stored.
- **--remove:** deletes the file, and a second run says there's none (exit 0). `remove <id>` deletes the token too.
- **The hidden reader:** spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', HIDDEN_READER_SOURCE, 'P: '], { input: 'sk-ant-oat01-' + 'a'.repeat(40) + '\n' }) gives exactly that line on stdout and only 'P: ' on stderr. Empty input exits 1.
